name: Bernuy de Porreros (Spain)
description: Square flag quartered white and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Bernuy de Porreros (a saint on white and the aqueduct of Segovia on red).
history: Bernuy de Porreros adopted its arms and flag officially on 11 February 1997, published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 3 March 1997; the flag is square, of proportion 1:1.

features.role: Bernuy de Porreros arms — saint on white and the aqueduct of Segovia on red
